savings.reason: Sections 1-4 govern only the Board, which terminates under section 4(b). No independent continuing directive or express savings appears in the original or EO13138. The travel-expense authorization is incident to intermittent Board service and does not perpetuate the Board or its advisory/support duties. Any accrued reimbursement liability arises under the referenced general law, rather than a live independent command of this order.

research_rationale: The complete original establishes and administers only the President’s Advisory Board on Race. Section 4(b) expressly terminates the Board on September 30, 1998 unless the President extends it before that date. All original establishment, membership, advisory, coordination, support, travel, and FACA-delegation commands depend on that Board; no independent continuing command appears. No extension is identified in the dossier’s bounded later-source searches, and EO13138 section 3(e) expressly treats the Board as already terminated with its work completed. Therefore September 30, 1998 is the first end, with EO13138 revocation a later event effective September 30, 1999 under its section 9. The possibility of an unidentified unpublished extension alone supplies no affirmative contrary lead. No dossier conflicts precede acceptance of the search IDs. OFR catalog and saved-text searches and the eCFR search through the legal cutoff are adequate bounded counterevidence searches for this post-1937 NO order; the US Code search explicitly stops at October 9, 2026 and is supplementary only, not a current affirmative predicate. Full-corpus freeze audit confirms the original and complete EO13138 actor text are byte-identical as dossier text to those already read, and all 15 clause texts/offsets are unchanged. The new dossier adds alternate extracted-text term records with identical support-condition and September 30, 1998 sunset wording, changes source paths/metadata, changes actor variant IDs and machine scope to partial, and records 101 excluded generic references. Reading EO13138 section 3(e) resolves the machine partial label: it names EO13050 without section limitation, while section 3(c) expressly limits a different order to sections. Thus EO13050 is formally revoked in full on September 30, 1999 by section 9. That later cleanup cannot displace section 4(b)’s earlier Board termination on September 30, 1998. Section 1 continuances in EO13138 do not include this Board; no extension or earlier ending is affirmatively identified. All establishment, advisory, coordination, administrative, travel and FACA functions depend on the Board; accrued general-law reimbursements do not continue Board authority. Original/source page-check flags remain false; no official image inspection is represented. New missing/conflicts/current-law leads remain empty; machine search entries are unchanged, so their bounded-search adequacy and US Code October 9 coverage limitation are retained. All conflicts/metadata discrepancies are addressed before retaining the search IDs.
